name: fuelwatch
description: FuelWatch Tuguegarao - run both apps from root

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm run --prefix backend setup
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "API,WEB" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
